# Change-points
## Identify change-points
```{r}
### cpt analysis
ssbcpts <- cpt.mean(data = SSB_full$SSB, method = "BinSeg", Q = 6)
plot(ssbcpts, type = "l", cpt.col = "navyblue", xlab = "Index", pt.widt = 4)
cpts(ssbcpts)
#### Index: 4,    18,   20,   40,   54,   72
#### Years: 1950, 1964, 1966, 1986, 2000, 2018

### bcp analysis
bcp.ssb <- bcp(SSB_full$SSB)
plot(bcp.ssb, main = "SSB")
which(bcp.ssb$posterior.prob >= 0.5)
#### Index: 20,   37,   54
#### Years: 1966, 1983, 2000

#### Changepoints detected by both methods +-1 year and min. 5 years between points:
#### 1966, 2000
#### Opinion: would include 1986/1983 (looks significant) as only detected by BinSeg
```

## Plot Change-point regimes
```{r}
### Load plotting function from "functions.R"
source("R/functions.R")

### Call function
plot_SSB_cpt_full <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = SSB_full, 
              changepoints = c(1966, 1986,2000), 
              ribbon_colors = c("steelblue", "orange", "grey", "purple"),
              vline_colors = c("black", "grey", "black"),
              component = "Full Stock", 
              SSB_column = "SSB", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd", 
              show_hlines = TRUE)
plot_SSB_cpt_full
```

## Save plots
```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SSB_cpt_full,

       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Hysteresis
## Analysis
```{r}
### Check for time-lags
#SSB_test <- SSB_full[-75,]?
ccf(head(SSB_full$SSB, -2), ICES_data$F, type = "correlation") # 3 years lag

#### make time-lag object
SSB_F_lag$year <- SSB_full$year[-(77:79)]
SSB_F_lag$SSB <- SSB_full$SSB[-(1:3)]
SSB_F_lag$F <- ICES_data$F[-(78:77)]
SSB_F_lag <- as_tibble(SSB_F_lag)


### Break-point analysis
bpts <- strucchange::breakpoints(SSB_F_lag$SSB/1000000 ~ SSB_F_lag$F)
plot(bpts)
summary(bpts)

bpts_sum <- summary(bpts)
opt_brks <- opt_bpts(bpts_sum$RSS["BIC",])
opt_brks #### 4
bpts2 <- strucchange:: breakpoints(bpts, breaks = opt_brks)
best_brk <- SSB_F_lag$F[bpts2$breakpoints]
best_brk
####  0.28 1.09 0.28 0.22

par(mfrow = c(1,1))
ci_mod <- confint(bpts, breaks = opt_brks)
plot(SSB_F_lag$SSB/1000000 ~ SSB_F_lag$F, type = "p")
for (i in 1: opt_brks) {
  abline(v = SSB_F_lag$F[ci_mod$confint[i,2]], col = "blue")
  abline(v = SSB_F_lag$F[ci_mod$confint[i,1]], col = "red", lty = 3)
  abline(v = SSB_F_lag$F[ci_mod$confint[i,3]], col = "red", lty = 3)
}
#get corresponding years:
best_brk_years <- SSB_F_lag$F$year[bpts2$breakpoints]
best_brk_years
#### 1960, 1971, 1986, 2003
```

## Plotting
```{r}
# Simplified hysteresis plot for regime shifts

# Create time period factor (cleaner than manual color assignment)
SSB_F_lag$period <- cut(SSB_F_lag$year, 
                    breaks = c(-Inf, best_brk_years[1], best_brk_years[2], best_brk_years[3], best_brk_years[4], Inf),
                    labels = c("Pre 1960", "1960 to 1971", "1972 to 1986", "1987 to 2003", "Post 2003"))

# Define colors
period_colors <- c("Pre 1960" = "steelblue", 
                  "1960 to 1971" = "darkorange", 
                  "1972 to 1986" = "purple",
                  "1987 to 2003" = "lightgreen",
                  "Post 2003" = "indianred")

# Key years for labeling (replace row numbers with actual years)
key_years <- c(1960, 1971, 1986, 2003)
label_data <- SSB_F_lag[SSB_F_lag$year %in% key_years, ]

# Create plot
plot_hyst <- ggplot(SSB_F_lag, aes(x = F, y = SSB/1000000)) +
  
  # Trajectory path
  geom_path(color = "grey", size = 0.8) +
  
  # Reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1130747/1000000, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.32, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
  
  # Data points colored by period
  geom_point(aes(color = period), size = 2) +
  
  # Trend lines by period
  geom_smooth(aes(color = period), method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  
  # Color scale
  scale_color_manual(values = period_colors, name = "Time Period") +
  
  # Reference labels
  annotate("label", x = 0.32, y = 1130747/1000000, label = expression("F"[MSY]), 
           color = "gray30", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("label", x = 0.55, y = 1130747/1000000, label = expression("MSY B"[trigger]), 
           color = "gray30", size = 3.5) +
  
  # Year labels for key points
  geom_text_repel(data = label_data, aes(label = year), 
                  color = "black", size = 3, 
                  point.padding = 0.2, segment.size = 0.2) +
  
  # Formatting
  xlim(0, 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Fishing Mortality (F)", y = "SSB (million tonnes)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.background = element_blank()
  )

# Display plot
plot_hyst
```
